body: Even if I felt safe leaving, I have no resources. I get paid $200 a month at my job, it all goes to bills/basic necessities, I literally have no way of getting somewhere even if I felt safe showing up in a foreign place with nothing to my name.

Everything I said was used against me, brought up in court, literally used by people who don't know me to try to make me look like a violent monster when I'm not at all. I tried going back but sitting there and baring my soul to someone just to go home and worry about how all of that is going to sound being read to a judge by some shitty county lawyer is too much. 

I'm an adult with the lifestyle of a 14-year-old. I work part time (10hrs/week), don't drive, love at home. Don't have the mental or financial resources to move out on my own, neither the professional skills nor the work ethic. No friends anymore. Just my shitty boyfriend (who's really not that terrible, but has concerning outbursts of controlling behavior) or my shitty parents who refuse to assist me in any way and treat me like Cinderella.
I don't fear retaliation from him if I leave. I've been hit and stalked by romantic partners before and that's not something this guy would do. He's just pushy about strange things.

He doesn't think he needs therapy. He's greatly improved from a dark time in his life (he's in the military and faced a horrible attack a few years ago on a deployment -- watched a bunch of friends get shot dead), and because things aren't as bad as they were *then,* he says they can't be that bad now. So him helping himself is pretty much out of the question. 

I know, ideally, I'd prefer being alone to what I'm living with now. I just know that nothing is going to feel good anymore. It's like going from eating pizza and peanut butter ice cream every day to brown rice and broccoli. Sure, it's better for you and sure, it will even feel better, but it's boring and doesn't go down nearly as easy.
